title: Discrimination of ranges of closely related RNA targets using CRISPR-based detection assay developed using machine learning-based optimization
summary: The primary publisher Methods/Results support the AI-enabled result: CRISPR-Cas13a assay with ML-designed guide sets discriminating SARS-CoV-2 from twelve sarbecoviruses, validated with in vitro data; distinct assay result with an identified ML design role. The result is reported in the Scientific Reports. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
